geopolitics_summary: Ukraine escalates strikes on Russian energy infrastructure; EU sanctions on Russian LNG imminent; heat waves intensify climate policy focus across Europe.

themes.headline: EU shipyard services Russian LNG fleet ahead of incoming sanctions
themes.why_it_matters: Accelerated servicing extends Russian LNG supply capacity despite sanctions, keeping global LNG supply elevated and TTF arbitrage weak. Delays to sanctions implementation extend Russian revenue flows.

themes.headline: Ukrainian drones strike Omsk refinery; Russia faces acute fuel crisis
themes.why_it_matters: Russian refinery damage reduces domestic fuel production, forcing imports. Indirectly supports crude prices and fuel-to-gas switching pressure; minimal direct EU power impact but geopolitical risk premium on oil affects energy basket hedging.

themes.headline: Belgian and French heat waves claim lives; government accountability scrutiny increases
themes.why_it_matters: Extreme heat drives demand spikes (AC load, industrial cooling) and strains thermal/nuclear plant cooling-water availability. Political pressure may accelerate climate/energy transition spending. Summer 2026 demand risk on DA/Cal+1 spreads.

themes.headline: Germany indicts Ukrainian over Nord Stream sabotage; alleges Kyiv-backed operation
themes.why_it_matters: Political/legal escalation reopens pipeline questions but Nord Stream remains destroyed. Reinforces EU gas isolation from Russian supplies; supports LNG demand narrative and TTF price floor. Minimal immediate transmission but signals hardening geopolitical stance.

themes.headline: Ireland assumes EU presidency amid French election; energy/climate agenda fluid
themes.why_it_matters: Six-month Irish presidency may slow EU ETS policy decisions and renewable subsidies if decision-making stalls pre-French election. Watch for delays on capacity market rules, CBAM implementation, or grid upgrade funding affecting 2027 auction calendars.

watchlist: EU sanctions on Russian LNG fleet implementation date and scope — impact on global LNG supply and TTF.
French and Belgian heat-wave recovery/demand normalisation — summer load forecasts for DA/Cal+1.
Irish presidency energy/climate agenda — watch for ETS auction schedule, capacity market, grid investment timelines.
Ukraine-Russia energy war escalation — refinery/pipeline attacks could trigger energy supply volatility spikes.
